4 اركز He (a man) found what is termed رِكَاز: (S, A, * K:) or his mine yielded him abundance of silver &c.: (TA:) or he found a [quantity of gold or silver equal to a sum of money such as is termed] بَدْرَة, collected together, in the mine. (Es-Sháfi'ee, TA.) ―
-b2- It (a mine) had in it what is termed رِكَاز: (K:) or what is so termed was found in it. (IAar, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
